packageRules.description: Lock file maintenance delegates resolution to the package manager, so its updates carry no release timestamp; under Renovate 42's default minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour=timestamp-required, the repository-wide minimumReleaseAge keeps renovate/stability-days pending forever and the PR never automerges. The cooldown for yarn.lock is enforced by npmMinimalAgeGate in .yarnrc.yml instead (https://docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/minimum-release-age/#lockfilemaintenance-updates)
Automerge non-major updates, except for 0.x where minor is breaking
Keep yarn resolutions on auto range strategy
The configs pin the version of the linter that they run (markuplint, stylelint, textlint), and the root lists the same version to have its binary: they move together
oxlint runs the type-aware rules through oxlint-tsgolint, which has to be the version that oxlint asks for

The ESLint that scripts/pug-to-tsx-types.spec.ts runs the config of @d-zero/eslint-config on: it stays at the version that the config pins, or the rules of the config run on another major. The ESLint of packages/@kamado-io/oxlint (a different use) moves as usual

@d-zero/eslint-config is the oracle of the order of the imports that scripts/pug-to-tsx-types.spec.ts reads (docs/v3/development.md): it stays at the version that the spec was written against, and `yarn lint` no longer runs ESLint
hono and its official server adapter move together

react is also an oracle of v3 (see docs/v3/development.md); a release that changes its generated tables fails generate-jsx-tables.spec.ts or pug-to-tsx-types.spec.ts until they are regenerated in the same PR
The parser reads the tokens of the lexer, so they move together; acorn, the converter's third package, is independent of them
The source of a table that v2 does not decide: a release that changes the properties fails generate-css-tables.spec.ts until the table is regenerated in the same PR (docs/v3/development.md)
The oracle of crates/kd_jsonc/tests/edit_golden.json and edit_array_golden.json, which v2 does not decide: the goldens are regenerated in the same PR (docs/v3/development.md)

prettier-v2, esbuild-v2, character-entities and html-minifier-terser are the versions the published v2 page-compiler and jsx-compiler pin, the oracles of the HTML and JSX tables and differential checks; they do not move on their own (docs/v3/development.md). character-entities is also the table of named references that the --semantic mode of benchmarks/v3/compare-outputs.ts reads. The root esbuild (the runtime) is not an oracle and moves as usual
The v2 oracles are the published v2 on purpose and do not move (docs/v3/development.md)

cssnano, postcss and postcss-import are the versions the published v2 style compiler pins, the oracles of kd_css and of scripts/check-css-import.mjs; they do not move on their own (docs/v3/development.md)
postcss-custom-media is the version v2's @d-zero/postcss-config pins, the oracle of scripts/check-css-custom-media.mjs; it does not move on its own (docs/v3/development.md)
benchmarks/v2-baseline pins the published v2 and what it needs; it is not kept up to date
